message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on facts: The defendant Song allowed drug user Liu to inject heroin at his residence four times, and was caught with heroin. This is likely "容留他人吸毒罪" (allowing others to use drugs) under Chinese criminal law. Also possession of heroin may be "非法持有毒品罪" (illegal possession of narcotics). The facts: He "容留吸毒人员刘某某注射毒品海洛因" - that is the crime of "容留他人吸毒罪". Also he was found with heroin (12 small bags, 2.01g). That could be "非法持有毒品罪". However the question: "只写这部分事实直接支持的罪名". The facts support both crimes: container for drug use and possession. Under Chinese law, "容留他人吸毒罪" is separate. Also "非法持有毒品罪" requires possession of narcotics. He had heroin in his home. So both apply.

Thus answer: [罪名]容留他人吸毒罪;非法持有毒品罪<eoa>
